caseName: The Partner Who Always Covered for Me
title: Noor & Celeste

questions.text:
I keep thinking I'm losing it, so let's start small.
A few weeks ago I opened alone at five. Two hundred croissants, just me and the radio.
She swears she lined someone up to come in with me. I don't remember any name.
Who was supposed to cover that shift with me?

So she did ask someone, and I still ended up alone. 😔
Last week we ran out of flour mid-bake. Forty loaves short and a line out the door.
She handles every order. I just know the bags stopped coming.
Which supplier dropped us?

I couldn't pick that company out of a lineup.
She says it went through on my login. I'm in bed by nine and up at 3:40, every night for five years.
What time did that cancellation actually go through?
questions.hint: Check the open tabs in Safari.

questions.text:
That's the middle of the night. I was asleep. I know I was. 😤
Then there's the Whitcomb wedding tasting. She told me three o'clock. I got there at two-thirty with samples and they'd already left.
What time was it actually booked for?
questions.hint: Look at past events in her Calendar.

questions.text:
So the tasting I 'missed' was never mine to miss.
Now the staff go quiet when I walk in. Someone's saying I screamed at them in the walk-in.
I've yelled at an oven. Never at a person.
Who's been saying that?
questions.hint: Check her WhatsApp chats with the bakery staff.

questions.text:
She was my first hire. I taught her to laminate dough. 🥲
Celeste promised me she'd smoothed things over with her.
What reason did Celeste give her for how I've been acting?
questions.hint: Check her Messages with that staff member.

onboarding.text: I'm Noor. Head baker at Proof & Crumb in Portland. Four a.m., every day, for five years. Lately I keep making mistakes I can't remember making, and I'm scared it's me.
onboarding.label: Noor

onboarding.text: Celeste Moreau is my business partner. She runs the front and the books; I run the ovens. Every time I slipped this summer, she covered for me. Smiled, fixed it, told me not to worry.
onboarding.label: Noor & Celeste

onboarding.text: She left her phone at the shop tonight. I've never once looked at it. But the staff go quiet when I walk in now, and I need to know what she really thinks of me.
onboarding.label: Celeste

onboarding.text: My divorce nearly broke me. This bakery is what I rebuilt from it. Help me go through her phone, one question at a time. She'll be back for it at six.
onboarding.label: Noor

msgs.text: Croissant batch two is GORGEOUS. Come look before they go out
Omw, save me the ugly one 😂
There's no ugly one. I'm a professional
Wrist is killing me today. Brace is on, still hurts
Go home at noon. I've got the front. Don't argue 💛
Whitcomb tasting tmrw at 3!
3. Got it. I'll bring the lemon olive oil and the brown butter ones
Perfect 💛
Celeste. I got there at 2:30 and they were gone. I swear you said three 😔
Hon, I think I said eleven. It's ok, I covered it and Priya was sweet about it
I'm losing it. I'm actually losing it
You're not. You're tired. Don't worry about it 💛
Talked to Mari. Smoothed it over. Don't bring it up with her ok?
What did she even say. I've never raised my voice at her
It's handled. Just let it go for now, ok?
Ok. 😤 Fine. For now
Skipping my draw this month too. We're in it together 🫶
You don't have to do that. But thank you. Seriously
Got someone to open w you tmrw, don't stress 💛
Thank god. 200 croissants alone is no joke
Nobody came. Just me and the radio. Did you say someone was coming??
I did?? Hon, you told me you wanted it solo. It's ok!!
I don't remember saying that. 😔
We're OUT of bread flour??
The supplier says it was cancelled from our portal login. You're the only other one with it, hon. It's ok!!
I was asleep. I'm always asleep. Forty loaves short and a line out the door
I'll run to the restaurant depot for a few bags. Take a breath 💛
Can we talk next week? Somewhere away from the shop. I'll bring someone you trust. I love you, you know that.
That sounds serious. Is everything ok?
Everything's fine, I just want to look after you. Get some sleep ❤️
Ok. I'm making you the pistachio ones tomorrow 🥖
Fernhill Flour Co: Hi Celeste, this is Dwight. Pastry flour pallet is on the truck for delivery tomorrow morning.
Thanks Dwight. What window?
Between six and eight AM. Driver will call.
Perfect, we'll have the back door unlocked
Delivered. Signed by Tomás. Invoice going to your email.
Got it, thank you
Quick heads up, rye flour prices are going up about four percent next month.
Ugh. Is that across the board or just rye?
Rye and whole wheat. Everything else holds for now.
Can I lock in the current price for a few more weeks?
If you order before the end of the month, yes.
Then I'll put in an order today. Same as last time, plus two extra bags of rye
Noted. Order confirmed, delivery in two days.
Hi Celeste, one bag of whole wheat came in torn. Want a credit or a replacement?
Credit is fine. We had a spare bag and used it
Credit applied to the next invoice. Sorry about that.
No worries, these things happen
Reminder: June invoice is due in five days.
Paying it this week, thank you
Payment received. Thanks Celeste!
Fernhill Flour Co.: Your pastry flour order has shipped. Expected delivery tomorrow before noon.
Thanks! Please leave it at the back door.
Noted. Driver will text on arrival.
Delivered. Left at back door, photo on file.
Received, thank you
Do you carry organic spelt? A customer asked about a spelt loaf
We do. Fifty pound bags, a bit pricey. I can send a sample bag.
Sample would be great. Noor wants to test it
Sending with Thursday's truck. Tell her to go easy on the hydration, spelt is thirsty then sulky.
😂 I'll pass that on word for word
Truck is running late, expect delivery around ten.
That's fine, we're open anyway
Reminder: we're raising rye flour prices slightly next month due to harvest costs. New sheet is in your inbox.
How much of an increase?
About four percent. We can lock current pricing for sixty days if you confirm by Friday.
Please lock it. I'll send a PO this afternoon.
Locked. Thanks for the quick answer!
Delivered at the front by mistake, driver left it with the barista.
Found it, we moved it inside. All good
Great. Our fall catalog is out. Want me to email you the PDF?
Please. I'm trying to trim costs this quarter
Understood. I put a note on the bulk discount page. Ten percent over five pallets.
We don't move that much, but good to know
Could do a split order with another bakery in the area. Happens a lot.
Interesting. Let me think about it
Do you carry whole wheat pastry flour in 25 lb bags?
Weekly reminder: orders for next week close tomorrow at noon.
Thanks, sending ours this afternoon
Yes, 25 lb and 50 lb. Want a sample bag?
Order received. Pastry flour, whole wheat, rye, and the extra butter slab from Bluebird.
Looks right. Thanks Dwight
Anytime. Have a good one.
Natural wine tonight? That new place on Division has a patio
Yes. I need a glass of something funky after today
Meet at 7?
7 works. I'll lock up and walk over
Are you coming in early tomorrow or can I open the counter?
You open, I'll be in by eight. Need to hit the bank first
Cool. The register is being weird again, FYI
Restart it twice, it likes drama
That orange wine was SO good 🍷
The skin-contact one? I'm buying a bottle at the Cellar
Get two. I'll pay you back
Natural wine Friday? There's a new orange wine at the Cellar I want you to try
Orange wine. I'm in
After close, I'll walk over with you
Hot yoga tomorrow? My hamstrings are crying
Can't, I'm opening the counter. Next week
Okay okay. Wear shorts you don't care about, the studio is a sauna
lol noted
That orange wine tasted like a peach pit and a hug 🍑
Best description ever. We're buying a case
We are not buying a case. We're buying one bottle and I'm paying my card down
Boo. Fine. Responsible Celeste
Did you see the review that called our scones 'life-altering'?
I printed it and taped it to the register
I knew you would 😂
Natural wine place on Division has a new orange one. Happy hour on October 15?
Yes. I need it. Put it on the calendar
Done. 4:30 ok?
Perfect 🍷
Happy hour at the Pearl spot, half off oysters
I'm in. Give me forty minutes to finish the tip count
Take your time, I'll order us a round 😘
Can I swap shifts next week? My cousin's in town
Yes, tell me which days and I'll fix the schedule
Tuesday and Wednesday off, please. I'll make it up the following week
Done. Go see your cousin
You're a good boss
I'm a tired boss who likes you. Enjoy it
The grinder is doing the screeching thing again
Unplug it, wait ten minutes, try again. I'll call the repair guy
worked 🙌
Wine tonight? That natural orange from the new place?
Perfect, I'll grab a table
Running 10 min late
Take your time, I'm on the first glass 🍷
Rude. Almost there
Can I leave at 2 today? Cat thing
Go. Hug the cat for me 🐈
Orange wine night was a win. I'm ordering a case
A case?? Check your budget first, I'm in no position to lecture but still
Half a case. Compromise
Fine. Can you open Saturday morning? I'm doing a long run
Yep I'll take the counter. Go be a gazelle
Thank you. Croissant shipment will be small, I told the oven crew
Got it. Hot yoga after? I need to sweat out the wine
Ember at six? I'll book us two mats
Perfect 🙌
Booked. Bring water, the last class nearly killed me
Sellwood Auto Repair: Hi Celeste, your Subaru is ready for an oil change and tire rotation. Reply to schedule.
Hi! Can I come in early morning tomorrow?
We open at 7:30. Drop it off anytime after.
See you then
Your car is done. We noticed the rear brake pads are getting thin.
How thin? And how much to replace them?
About three millimeters left. Replacement is roughly $280 parts and labor.
Ouch. Can it wait a month or two?
I'd say six weeks tops. If you hear grinding, come in right away.
Understood. Picking up the car in an hour
Sellwood Auto Repair: Thanks for your payment of $84.50. We appreciate your business!
Reminder: your registration renewal is due soon, we can help with the emissions test.
Oh right, thanks for the nudge. Do you take walk-ins?
Yes, morning is best. Takes about twenty minutes.
I'll stop by this week
Passed the emissions test. Certificate is at the front desk.
Great, grabbing it on my way home
Sellwood Auto Repair: Your car is ready for pickup. Total is $284.50.
Thanks! What was the extra charge?
Replaced a worn serpentine belt and rotated tires. Invoice in your email.
Okay, I'll come by tomorrow after work.
We close at 6, see you then.
Hi Celeste, car making a squeal when braking?
That's the pads wearing down. Bring it in and we'll get you in a slot today.
Can't today, the shop is slammed. Tomorrow before opening?
7:30 sharp. We'll do the rear pads first.
Perfect. Please just don't find anything else 😅
No promises. 😄
All done. Pads replaced, and we checked the wipers for free. Total $265.
A little less than quoted, thank you
We rounded in your favor. See you in six months.
Can you split the payment? Half now, half on the first of the month?
Sure, no problem. We'll keep a note on the account.
Thank you, really appreciate it
Sellwood Auto Repair: A payment of $132.50 was received. Balance remaining: $132.50.
Reminder: your next oil change is due in about 500 miles.
Thanks, I barely drive. Mostly bakery runs.
Do you want to book anyway? We have openings next week.
Yes, mornings are best
Booked for 8 AM. See you then.
Sellwood Auto Repair: Friendly reminder, remaining balance of $132.50 is due today.
Paying it right now, sorry for the delay
Received, thank you! Account is clear.
Any chance you do a quick check on my AC? It's been weak lately
We can look. Might just need a recharge, around $120.
I'll roll the windows down for now. Maybe after the race
Sounds good. Good luck with the race!
Thanks! You remembered
You mentioned it three times 😄
Ha, guilty. See you in the fall
Also, check tire pressure in the heat, a few are low
Will do, thanks!
Sellwood Vet Clinic: Reminder that Brioche is due for his annual wellness exam. Reply YES to request an appointment.
YES
Thanks! We have openings next Tuesday afternoon or the following Thursday morning. Which works?
Thursday morning please, before the bakery gets busy
Booked for 8:30 with Dr. Alvarez. Please keep Brioche fasting after midnight if we're doing bloodwork.
Will do. He is going to hate me
Reminder: Brioche's appointment is tomorrow at 8:30 AM.
Hi Celeste, Brioche's annual wellness exam is due. Want to schedule?
Yes please, something next week after 2 PM?
We have 3:30 PM open next week. Does that work?
Perfect
Booked. Please bring a stool sample if you can.
Ha, will do 😬
Brioche's labs look great. Dr. Alvarez suggests a dental cleaning in the fall. We'll mail an estimate.
Thank you! Can you also send the refill for his kidney-support food?
Refill is ready for pickup at the front desk anytime.
Perfect, I'll grab it after my run tomorrow.
Got it, see you then 🐾
Reminder: Brioche's appointment is tomorrow at 3:30 PM.
See you then
Sellwood Vet Clinic: Reminder, Brioche has an annual exam on October 18 at 4:00 PM. Reply C to confirm.
C
Thanks! Please withhold food after midnight the night before if bloodwork is needed.
Good morning sweetheart, did you eat breakfast?
Morning Mom. Pastry counts right? I'm surrounded by it
A croissant is not breakfast Celeste
It has butter, eggs, flour. That's basically a food group
Your father used to say the same thing 😄
The tomatoes are finally coming in. I'll save you a bag when you visit
Yes please!! Cherry ones if you have them
Juliette says you haven't called in two weeks
I know, I know. It's been a crazy stretch at the shop. I'll call Sunday
Okay. I just like hearing your voice
Dr. Chen moved my appointment again. This phone thing is so confusing
Did they text you a new time?
Yes but I can't find it. There is a little green bubble
Mom, tap the Messages icon, it's the green one with the white bubble
Found it! Next Tuesday at two. Thank you honey
Perfect. Text me after how it goes
All fine. Blood pressure a little high, he says less salt
Less salt?? You put salt on watermelon
Don't tease your mother
I'm not! I'm worried. Do the walks, ok? Juliette said you stopped
It's been too hot. I walk at the mall now with Barb
The mall counts. Barb is a good influence
How is the running? Still training for that long race?
Half marathon, yes. Did ten miles this morning. My knees hate me
Ten miles! I get tired driving that far
Ha. I'll send you a photo of the finish line if I make it
I will put it on the fridge next to your trophy from third grade
Please don't. That was a participation ribbon
Hi sweetheart, did you get the box of plums from Mrs. Dunning's tree? I had her send some
Not yet Mom, maybe tomorrow. Thank you!
They're a little soft so eat them fast
They came! Already made a galette 😍
Of course you did. Take a picture next time
Will do. How's the knee?
Better. The physical therapist says to keep walking. Your sister drove me.
Good. I'll try to come down for a weekend soon
You always say that. I know the bakery is busy. Just eat something besides pastry
Mom 😂 I eat vegetables
Is the cat still eating the plants?
Brioche ate the basil. Again. He looked me in the eye while doing it
😂 Smart cat
Ha. Is Brioche still shedding on everything
Aunt Colette is coming for Thanksgiving. Are you able to make it this year?
That's months away Mom. I'll try, bakery is slammed that week though
You always say try
I know. I'll look at flights. Promise
Everything. The vet says he's healthy though
Good. Love you, call me Sunday
Love you too ❤️ I'll call after my long run
You sound tired when we talk. Are you okay, really?
Just work stuff. Long hours. I'm fine Mom, I promise
Eat a real dinner tonight. I love you
Love you too ❤️ Tell Barb hi
Hey stranger! Long time. Coffee soon?
Hannah!! Yes. I've been a terrible friend, I'm sorry
Stop, you run a bakery. I get it
Still. Come by the shop, I'll make you a latte and slip you a morning bun
The cardamom one? I've been dreaming about it
I'll save two
That bun was criminal. Thank you 😍
Come back anytime. How's the new apartment?
Boxes everywhere. I found a whole box of cables from 2014
Throw them out. You will never need them
That's what I said and then I kept them
Book club moved to the first week of next month. Did you finish the novel?
Page one hundred. I'm a fraud
Same. We'll just drink wine and say the ending was sad
Genius. Guess that's the whole plan
Did you see the new wine bar on Milwaukie Ave?
I walked by! They have a whole list of pét-nats
Take me. I'll even wear real shoes
Real shoes! Big night
That place was incredible. I'm still thinking about the cheese board
And the waiter who kept calling us ladies 😂
Ha! Also you left your sunglasses. I have them
Oh thank god. Those were an expensive mistake
I'll drop them at the shop tomorrow
You're a saint
Hey, are we still on for the half-marathon training plan swap? I have a spreadsheet
Yes please. I'm at ten miles and my left knee is grumbling
Foam roll and a rest day. Sending the sheet now
Got it. Taper looks reasonable
You'll do great. Don't skip the long run next week
Question: do you know a good electrician? My outlet sparked
Sparked?? Unplug everything. My landlord has a guy, I'll send his number
Thank you. Already unplugged, living by candlelight like it's 1850
Romantic. Dangerous. Very you
Springwater tomorrow at 5:45?
Yes. I'll bring the electrolytes
That was brutal but fun 😅
Humid. Pancakes after?
I make better pancakes. Come over, bring berries
Deal
He came and fixed it in twenty minutes. Whole thing was a loose wire
Phew. Glad you're not on fire
Me too. Going to Mt. Hood next month for a hike. Come with?
I'd love to. Which weekend? I have to see who can cover the counter
The second one. I'll send details
I'll bring trail snacks. Hazelnut shortbread
Now I'm definitely coming
New shoes arrived! Tempted to race in them
You okay? You seemed a bit off at book club
Just tired. Money stuff and work stuff. Nothing a nap won't fix
Okay. I'm here if you need to talk. Truly
I know. Thank you. ❤️
Hey, can I swap my Saturday close with Dev? He said he's cool with it.
If Dev's good and the schedule doc is updated, yes.
Updated it just now
Thanks. Can you also restock the cup sleeves before you leave tonight?
On it
Can I swap Saturday for next week? Cousin's quinceañera
Sure, find someone to take it and I'll approve
Bea said yes
Perfect, done
Card reader keeps freezing at the register. Rebooted twice
Ugh. Unplug it for thirty seconds and try again. If not, use the phone one.
That worked. Line was out the door too 😅
The morning rush at least means the croissants moved
Question, can I take a half day next week for my cousin's quinceañera? Only the morning
Of course! Just tell me which morning so I can cover the register.
The 25th, I'll be back by 1
Got it, marked on the calendar 🗓️
Celeste, the display case light is flickering again
Ugh. Can you swap the bulb? Spares are in the office drawer
On it
Fixed. Also we're low on napkins
Ordering more tomorrow
Someone left a reusable tote under the counter. Blue with a fox on it
Put it behind the register, they'll come back for it
Spotify queue in the shop is just French pop again lol. Customers keep asking who it is
That's the point. It's called ambiance
Can we put on something with drums once in a while 🙏
Fine. One playlist of yours, afternoons only.
Deal. You're the best
Cool. Oh, can I swap a shift next week? My cousin's visiting
Sure, just post it in the schedule and find cover
Thanks, will do
Dish pit drain is slow again
Pour the enzyme stuff down it tonight. I'll order more
Celeste! Tasha from the Hawthorne farmers market. Are you still thinking about a booth in the fall?
Hi Tasha! Thinking, yes. Terrified, also yes
Totally normal. The first month is chaos, then you find your rhythm
What do you sell the most of?
Honestly? Cinnamon knots and cardamom buns. People line up before I'm even set up
We could do a seeded rye and the morning buns. I'll have to talk to my partner about capacity
Smart. Don't overcommit the ovens
Application is due end of next month. $60 fee plus insurance certificate
Insurance cert I can get from our broker. Thanks for the heads up
Do you use a card reader at your counter? Mine keeps dropping the connection
We switched to the little tablet kind last year. Way more stable. I'll send you the model name
You're a lifesaver
Also, do you know a good source for rye flour in small quantities?
Try Fernhill. They do 25-pound bags and the owner picks up the phone
Perfect, calling them today
Just submitted the market application 🤞
Yay!! I put in a good word with the organizer
You're the best. Wine soon, on me
I'm holding you to that
Rant: my mixer died mid-croissant lamination 😤
Oh no. Do you need to borrow ours? We have a spare in the back
Seriously? That would save my whole week
Come by after close. I'll leave it by the back door
Got it. Thank you thank you. I'll bring pastries
Bring me whatever is chocolate
The market got back to me, we're approved for the fall season!
CONGRATS 🎉 I'll introduce you to the neighbors on either side of your booth
Are the early mornings brutal?
Load-in is at 6. But you're a baker, you've been up for hours
Fair 😂
Do you want to split a pop-up tent? I found a good deal
Yes please, send me the link
Sent. $120 total, so $60 each
Venmo'd. Thank you!
Can you recommend a good wedding florist? Not the pricey kind
Try Wild Stem on Division, they did flowers for a bakery event of ours
Perfect, I'll message them
They gave me a quote and it's actually reasonable!
Yay! Are you doing a cake or dessert table?
Dessert table. Lemon, pistachio, and something chocolate
I can do all three. Come in for a tasting soon
Booking it. Thank you, truly 💛
Of course. You're going to be a gorgeous bride
Stop, I'm crying at my desk
Heads up, we're doing a bakers' social in a couple weeks at the brewery on Foster. Come!
Ooh. Count me in. I need to be around people who understand why I'm tired
Everyone there will understand 😅
Quick favor, can you share your lamination temperature chart? Mine's a mess
I'll find it and send a photo of the whiteboard. Might take me a day
No rush. You're a gem
Morning run tomorrow? Springwater, 5:45 at the Sellwood trailhead
I'm in. Easy pace though, my calves are toast
Easy pace, I promise
You lied. That was not easy
Eight minute miles is easy
For a gazelle 😤
Race is eight weeks out. Long run this weekend, twelve miles
Twelve?? Okay. Where do we start
Out and back to the Gresham end. Bring gels
Never again. Never. Ever
See you Tuesday
Yes. Obviously.
Found a new shoe store, they do gait analysis. Worth it?
Do it. I got fitted at Sellwood Running Co. last year and my shin pain vanished
That's the one I was looking at
New shoes. They feel like clouds
Break them in slowly. Short runs first
Yes coach
It's going to be 90 degrees by noon, let's start at 5
5 AM is when the ovens start at the shop 😅 but fine, I'll make it work
Ha. Bring me a bun and we're even
Bribery accepted
Concert tickets for the indie folk show go on sale in an hour, want to try together?
Yes!! I'll be at my laptop
Got two. Floor tickets 😭
Venmo you tonight
No rush. Dinner before?
That ramen place near the venue
Perfect
Fourteen miles done 🎉
I did thirteen and quit. My legs have opinions
Thirteen is the whole race distance. You're ready
Half marathon is thirteen point one. That point one is going to haunt me
The point one is where you find out who you are
Deep. Too deep before coffee
Playlist you sent is on repeat all week
The French stuff? Glad someone enjoys it
Send more
Sending a new one tomorrow
Taper starts in two weeks. Less miles, more sleep
Sleep. I vaguely remember it
Seriously. You look wrecked lately. Everything good at the bakery?
Busy season. Plus some partner stuff. I'll survive
Okay. Don't skip the stretching
Yes dad
Easy five tomorrow, 6 AM?
Make it 6:15, I have to feed the cat and bribe him not to scream
6:15. Fine
That felt good actually. First run in weeks where nothing hurt
Taper magic. Told you
Pasta dinner before the race at my place? I'll cook
Tri-County Produce: your weekly order is confirmed for delivery tomorrow before 7 AM. Reply CHANGE to edit.
CHANGE
Hi Celeste, this is Dolores in dispatch. What would you like to change?
Add two flats of strawberries and drop the rhubarb. We're out of room in the walk-in
Done. Two flats strawberries added, rhubarb removed
Thank you!
Heads up, the Hood strawberries are at peak. Price is down this week if you want to add more for jam
How much down?
$32 a flat, down from $38
Add four more flats. We'll make a big batch
Four more flats added. Total six this week
Delivery driver says the back door was locked at 6:15 this morning. He left the crates by the dumpster
Ugh, I'm so sorry. I'll make sure someone is there to let him in going forward
Appreciate it. The strawberries were fine, just warm
Lemons next week please. Forty pounds. Lemon tart season never ends
Forty pounds lemons, noted
Your invoice from last month is still open. Total is $842.50
Sorry, I'll pay that today. Card on file ok?
Yes, we'll run it
Payment received. Thanks Celeste
Peaches are coming in from Hood River starting next week. Want us to hold a few cases?
Yes. Hold three cases of the firm ones. I want to do a galette
Three cases held
One of the peach cases had a lot of bruising. Can I get a credit?
Absolutely. Send us a quick description of what you saw and we'll credit the invoice
Bottom layer, about a third were soft. I threw them out
Credit applied. Sorry about that
No problem, thanks for being quick about it
Reminder, we're closed on the Fourth next year, for planning ahead. Hope that's not a surprise
That's far away, but noted 😄
Blackberries are in. Local and sweet. Want them for the weekend special?
Yes! Add eight flats. We'll do a blackberry-lime scone
Eight flats added
Driver is running about twenty minutes late tomorrow. Traffic on the bridge
No problem, someone will be here
Do you want to keep the same order for next week?
Same, but swap blackberries for plums
Plums swapped in. Order confirmed
Thanks Dolores
Anytime. Have a great weekend!
Hi Celeste, it's Hollis from 2B. Your package was left at my door again. I'll leave it by your mat
Thank you!! Sorry about that, the driver keeps mixing up our units
No worries at all. Is that the cat food? It's heavy 😄
Twenty-four cans. Brioche has opinions about gravy
Quick question: the HOA is talking about repainting the stairwell. Do you have a color preference?
Anything but that beige. It looks like old frosting
Ha. I'll lobby for a soft green
You are my hero
Are you around the first week of June? I'm visiting my daughter in Boise
Yes! Do you need anything watered?
Just the tomato plants on the balcony. And please take any tomatoes that ripen
Deal. I'll bring you a loaf when you're back
The tomatoes are doing great, by the way. Two ripe ones already 🍅
Oh that's wonderful. Eat them!
Already did. With olive oil and salt. Standing at the sink
The only correct way
Back safe. Thank you for the plants. Brought you a jar of huckleberry jam
You didn't have to! I'm going to put it on a croissant immediately
Reminder that the water will be shut off tomorrow from 10 to 2 for the pipe work
Thanks, I'm filling the kettle and pretending I'm camping
Your cat has been yelling at my door again 😂
Oh no, did he escape?!
No, he's in your window. Just watching me take out the recycling like a tiny landlord
That tracks. He's very controlling
Would you mind if I borrowed a cup of sugar? I have a pie emergency
I run a bakery. I'll bring you a bag
I forgot, of course you do 🙈
Left it on your mat. Good luck with the pie
Pie was a hit. Thank you!
Heads up, there's a new parking sticker policy. Check your mailbox
Ugh, one more thing to pay for. Thanks for the warning
Do you still have my cast-iron pan? No rush, just realized I haven't seen it
Oh no, I do! It's in my cabinet. I'll bring it Sunday
Thank you. Also I'm going to need a loaf for the potluck
